intro.en: My current research uses MPAS to simulate extreme weather events, including extreme precipitation and heatwaves in Hong Kong.
intro.zh: 我目前主要使用 MPAS 模拟极端天气事件，包括香港的极端降水和热浪。

bio.en: I am an MPhil student at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, where I began in September 2026. My current research focuses on MPAS-URBAN. My background spans physical oceanography, atmospheric science and applied mathematics.
bio.zh: 我于 2026 年 9 月开始在香港科技大学攻读 MPhil，目前从事 MPAS-URBAN 研究。我的学术背景涵盖物理海洋学、大气科学和应用数学。

bioDetail.zh: 在爱丁堡大学的研究项目中，我使用准地转模型 pyqg 和卷积神经网络研究海洋湍流的超分辨率重建。此前，我研究了北冰洋中尺度涡旋及阿拉伯海热带气旋的变化。
bioDetail.en: My research at the University of Edinburgh focused on super-resolution of ocean turbulence using the quasigeostrophic model pyqg and convolutional neural networks. Previously, I studied Arctic mesoscale eddies and the drivers of tropical cyclone variability in the Arabian Sea.

description.en: Ongoing MPhil research at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, since September 2026.
description.zh: 自 2026 年 9 月起，在香港科技大学开展的 MPhil 研究工作。
使用 pyqg 生成数据并构建卷积神经网络，研究海洋中尺度湍流的超分辨率重建。爱丁堡大学研究项目，2024–2026。
description.en: Super-resolution of ocean mesoscale turbulence with pyqg simulations and convolutional neural networks. Research project at the University of Edinburgh, 2024–2026.

title.en: Mesoscale eddies in the Arctic Ocean

description.zh: 结合 HYCOM 与现场观测，研究加拿大海盆次表层反气旋涡的三维结构，以及北冰洋涡旋特征的季节变化。
description.en: Three-dimensional structure of a subsurface anticyclonic eddy in the Canada Basin and seasonal variability of Arctic eddies, using HYCOM and in-situ observations.

description.zh: 使用 IBTrACS 数据研究阿拉伯海热带气旋路径及变化驱动因素，分析其与 ENSO、IOD 等气候指数的联系。
description.en: Drivers of Arabian Sea tropical cyclone variability, using IBTrACS tracks and correlation analysis with climate indices including ENSO and the Indian Ocean Dipole.

name: Edinburgh
爱丁堡
title: Super-resolution of ocean turbulence
海洋湍流超分辨率重建
body: MScR research in Applied Mathematics, supervised by Dr. Jacob Page. I used the Python quasigeostrophic model pyqg as a data source and built a convolutional neural network to investigate super-resolution of ocean mesoscale turbulence.
在 Dr. Jacob Page 指导下开展应用数学 MScR 研究，使用 Python 准地转模型 pyqg 生成数据，构建卷积神经网络，探索海洋中尺度湍流的超分辨率重建。
outcome: Research work: model-generated data and a CNN-based super-resolution approach. I also tutored Python programming and Honours Differential Equations at the School of Mathematics.
研究工作包括模型数据生成与基于 CNN 的超分辨率方法；同时在数学学院承担 Python 编程及荣誉微分方程课程辅导。

name: Reading
雷丁
title: Drivers of Arabian Sea tropical cyclone variability
阿拉伯海热带气旋变化的驱动因素
body: BSc research in Atmospheric Sciences, supervised by Prof. Reinhard Schiemann. I visualized tropical cyclone trajectories using IBTrACS and examined correlations with climate indices including ENSO and the Indian Ocean Dipole.
在 Prof. Reinhard Schiemann 指导下开展大气科学本科研究，使用 IBTrACS 数据可视化热带气旋路径，分析其与 ENSO、印度洋偶极子等气候指数的相关性。
outcome: First-class honours in Atmospheric Sciences. Research connected cyclone tracks with large-scale climate variability.
获得大气科学一等荣誉学位；研究将气旋路径与大尺度气候变化联系起来。

name: Beijing
北京
institution: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
title: The three-dimensional life of an Arctic eddy
北冰洋涡旋的三维演变
body: During my master’s studies in Physical Oceanography at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences in Beijing, I used HYCOM and in-situ observations to investigate a subsurface anticyclonic eddy in the Canada Basin, its three-dimensional evolution and eddy-induced swirl transport. My wider work also examined seasonal variability of Arctic mesoscale eddies.
在北京中国科学院大学攻读物理海洋学硕士期间，结合 HYCOM 与现场观测数据，研究加拿大海盆次表层反气旋涡的三维演变和涡旋诱导的旋转输运，同时关注北冰洋中尺度涡旋的季节变化。
outcome: Published in Journal of Ocean University of China, 24, 545–556 (2025). Xu, F., Li, H., Wang, R., et al.
成果发表于 Journal of Ocean University of China, 24, 545–556 (2025)，作者 Xu, F., Li, H., Wang, R., et al.。
